_comment: Recreation.gov lookouts to include even though FFLA's rentals page doesn't list them yet, plus per-facility season notes from docs/fire-lookout-research.md. Keyed by Recreation.gov facility id. season_status here overrides the status parsed from FFLA. Re-check every winter.

10373939.name: Red Oak Fire Lookout
10373939.season_notes: Opened Sept 8, 2026; rentable through Nov 30. 2027 season April 15 to Nov 30. $100/night.

notes_by_name.Hager Mountain: Winter only, Nov 15 to May 15. Staffed as a working lookout in summer.
notes_by_name.Walde: Normally winter-only, mid-December to late March.
notes_by_name.Spruce Mountain: USFS page has shown a site-closed banner. When open, mid-June to Oct 1, max 2 consecutive nights.
